name: Welcome email (original content)
response:
Dear Parents of {{first_name}},


Congratulations! We are pleased to let you know that your child {{first_name}} has been accepted into Walnut School! You are now an integral part of the Walnut Family and also our brand ambassador!


As you know, a good school education will compound better than any other investment for your child. You have made the right decision on that front by deciding to admit {{first_name}} into Walnut School.


Walnut Schools are progressive in every possible way. We have a very balanced learning and co-curricular system, due to which we can have many awesome features in addition to extra-curricular activities, subject-wise classrooms, and of course, the feature which we all love - NO school bag!


At Walnut, we believe that your child's future will be shaped and nurtured by the active and coordinated support of the parents, teachers and the school. {{first_name}} is now OUR child as well. We will be sharing the milestones of the child's academic progress, personality development and so much more!



This is an important email, so please save this for future reference!


BRAND AMBASSADOR APPRECIATION / REFERRALS


Since we are all part of the Walnut Family, we appreciate the trust that you have put in us for educating your child in the best possible school. We would love to have more parents like you who will work with the school in creating tough and smart citizens. We also have a referral program for all parents of Walnut school, where we offer a brand ambassador appreciation (which is reflected in the fees) per admission to show our appreciation. 


We have so many parents who are ardent supporters who got more than 10 referrals last year! And since the referrals have gotten stronger, we decided to make the appreciation stronger too. 


Here is a simple chart for the same :



Number of admissions referred for the academic year 23-24(Referral Discount) Brand Ambassador’s Appreciation (in INR)


11000
21500 (+1000 of the 1st admission) = 2500 total
32000 (+1000 of the 1st admission + 1500 of the 2nd admission) = 4500 total
42500 (+1000 of the 1st admission + 1500 of the 2nd admission + 2000 of the 3rd admission) = 7000 total
5For each additional one, Rs. 3000 (and obviously the calculation as explained for the earlier ones)


Looking forward to seeing our Walnut family grow further!


Your Next Steps:

Here is some information which will help you get acquainted with the system of Walnut School.

Know the heads of your school


The Principal of the school is {{principal}} and the vice_principal is {{vice_principal}}


The Administrative head of the school is {{admin_in_charge}}


The school contact details are as follows :

Phone number : +91-20-35007900

Email address : feedback@walnutedu.in

You can seek an appointment with the principal or the coordinator, by writing to our email address


Reference number


Every child of Walnut School is allotted a reference number, which stays with the child forever. The format of the reference number is {Letter}{Letter}{Number}{Number}. So, for {{first_name}}, the reference number is {{refno}}. Be sure to quote the reference number in all correspondence with the school. That way, we can easily get access to all the information pertaining to your child.


Orientation


We send out an orientation video before school starts, which gives you an overview of how things are in that meeting from members of our core team. After that we will have a detailed orientation for you where you will get detailed information about every subject and the activities over the year from the actual teachers who will be interacting with the child. 


Meet and greet


We know you are intent to meet the entire Walnut team. We are equally intent to meet you too! Hence, we organize a meet and greet session on one of the weekends of June, where you get to informally interact with the teachers, and also get to meet other parents from your child’s batch.


PTM


You get to interact with every subject teacher that is teaching your child. These meetings are organized online via Google Meet. The links for these will be shared with you via the school’s app.


Walmiki


As part of our academics, we provide e-Learning content via our own Walmiki app to the students, making it easier for them to revise concepts at home. Each student has a personal login id and password, thus allowing for regular tracking of their individual academic progress. There are video lectures there for most of the topics in the core subjects and plenty of quizzes to practice as well. A lot of the competitive exam training also happens through this app. They also use it in school for their ongoing tests which are counted in the final result.

You can access Walmiki today! As you are now part of the Walnut Family, you can access the awesome Walmiki app from your Android phone or your favourite browser:


Here are the login details:

URL: https://walnutedu.net | Play Store

Username: {{refno}}

Password: 54321


Wal-Sh 


All information that needs to be sent to you over the year is communicated to the parents through our own app, which is called Wal-Sh. It is our preferred method of communication, and you can find all the circulars and other announcements updated there.

You can also access the Wal-Sh app today!

Here are the login details:

Download Wal-Sh from: Play Store | App Store

Username: {{refno}}

Password: OTP on your registered mobile devices


Email:


For accessing various online features of Walnut School, we have also created an email address for <>. Do note that the email address has the branch codes appended before the reference number.

Here are the login details for the same:

URL: http://mail.walnutedu.in

Username: {{user_email}}

Password: walnut@12345

This email address is to be used for all communication with Walnut School. You can even log in to this email address from your mobile device.


Follow us on Social Media:


You will be surprised to see how active we are on Facebook and Instagram! Follow us to get almost daily updates on what is happening in every branch of Walnut School. Here are our handles:

Facebook: https://fb.com/walnutedu

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/walnut.school/


Before school begins


Before school actually begins, we request you to collect the following things from school:


1. ID cards: Each child is given a set of two ID cards at the start of the year - one for the child, and a spare one.


2. Files: We have files which are given to each student for filing of worksheets per subject, that are sent home regularly. It is expected that the child files sheets every day, and the parents keep a check of what is received every day. Soft copies of the sheets are also available through the Wal-Sh app, in case some get lost.


3. Folder: This is all that the students have to carry to school every day! Why? You guessed it right – no school bag needed! :)


4. Uniform: The school uniform also needs to be ordered and collected from school in the first week of March. 


5. Fees: The fee schedule has been communicated to you via the rules and regulations. Please ensure that the school fees are also paid before school starts.


Transport


You must have already spoken to the transport provider by now. If you wish to avail transport and canteen facilities at additional cost, please contact:

Transport provider : {{transport_provider}}

Canteen provider : {{fcanteen_provider}}


We welcome you once again to the Walnut family and look forward to fruitful and exciting years ahead!


Warm Regards,

The Walnut School Administration Team.

response:
Dear Parents of  {{ first_name }} {{ last_name }} [{{ refno }}],

 

Since there have been a lot of questions after the earlier email, we are re-sending you the link for fees for the academic year 2023 - 24 and giving you more information about the process, amounts etc.


The last working day for the year 2022-23 is March 8 and the next academic year begins on March 20. To pay the fees, you can go to the {{ link }} here and follow the instructions mentioned.

After clicking on the link you will get the following details:-

  1. Which installment you are paying
  2. The due date for the present installment that you are paying

  4. Total discount given (if any : related to installments, referral, staff etc.) and late fee charges (if any)
  5. You will see options for payment mode that you can select. e.g. Net-banking, UPI, Credit cards and Debit Card


If you have any issues with the link above, please copy the link text below and paste it in your browser to initiate payment

{{ templink }}


Go through the RULES & REGULATIONS document, if you wish to look through more information. Check page 3 of that to see  

  1. Fee details for the upcoming academic years (till Std. 10).
  2. Plan wise installment amounts for different installments (for 2023-24)
  3. Fee installment plan wise due dates (for 2023-24)
  4. Fee installment plan wise total discounts (if any) (for 2023-24) 


After that, you will have to tick the check box of rules and regulations. Then, you will receive an OTP on the mobile number that is registered with the school. You will have to enter that OTP to proceed with the payment. 


 

आधीच्या ईमेलनंतर बरेच प्रश्न आले असल्याने, आम्ही तुम्हाला 2023 - 24 या शैक्षणिक वर्षाच्या फी ची लिंक पुन्हा पाठवत आहोत आणि तुम्हाला प्रोसेस, रक्कम इत्यादींबद्दल अधिक माहिती देत ​​आहोत.


शैक्षणिक वर्ष २०२२-२३ चा शेवटचा दिवस ८ मार्च असून नवीन शैक्षणिक वर्ष २० मार्च पासून सुरु होत आहे.


फी भरण्यासाठी, तुम्ही येथील {{ link }} वर जाऊन नमूद केलेल्या सूचनांचे पालन करा.


तुम्ही तुमच्या मुलाची फी {{ inst_count }} हप्त्यांमध्ये भराल.


लिंकवर क्लिक केल्यानंतर तुम्हाला खालील डिटेल्स मिळतील :-


  1. तुम्ही कोणता इन्स्टॉलमेन्ट भरत आहात
  2. तुम्ही भरत असलेल्या सध्याच्या इन्स्टॉलमेन्टची देय तारीख
  3. देय इन्स्टॉलमेन्टची एकूण रक्कम आणि विभाजन
  4. दिलेली एकूण सवलत (असल्यास: इन्स्टॉलमेन्ट, रेफरल, स्टाफ इत्यादींशी संबंधित) आणि लेट फी (असल्यास)
  5. तुम्हाला पेमेंट मोडचे पर्याय दिसतील जे तुम्ही निवडू शकता. उदा. नेट बँकिंग, UPI, क्रेडिट कार्ड आणि डेबिट कार्ड


वर दिलेली लिंक ओपन होत नसेल, तर खाली दिलेली लिंक कॉपी करा आणि ब्राउझर मध्ये टाका. {{templink}}


तुम्हाला अधिक माहिती पहायची असल्यास रूल्स आणि रेग्युलेशन पहा. ते पाहण्यासाठी पान 3 तपासा.


- पुढील शैक्षणिक वर्षांसाठी फी डिटेल्स (इयत्ता 10 पर्यंत).

- वेगवेगळ्या इन्स्टॉलमेन्टसाठीची रक्कम (२०२३-२४ साठी)

- इन्स्टॉलमेन्ट भरण्याचा तारखा (२०२३-२४ साठी)

- इन्स्टॉलमेन्ट असलेली एकूण सवलत (असल्यास) (२०२३-२४ साठी)


त्यानंतर, तुम्हाला रूल्स आणि रेग्युलेशनच्या चेक बॉक्सवर खूण करावी लागेल. त्यानंतर, तुम्हाला शाळेकडे नोंदणीकृत असलेल्या मोबाइल नंबरवर एक OTP प्राप्त होईल. पेमेंट करण्यासाठी तुम्हाला तो OTP टाकावा लागेल.
